hooks.command: bash -c 'cmd=$(python3 -c "import os,json; d=json.loads(os.environ.get(\"CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT\",\"{}\")); print(d.get(\"command\",\"\"))"); if echo "$cmd" | grep -qE "git commit"; then echo "--- Tests unitaires avant commit ---"; dotnet test --filter Category=Unit --no-build --nologo || exit 2; fi'
